title: Bugs per 100 commits, by the kind of work in the title
reading: Each bar is a rate: bugs fixed in the period studied that trace back to commits with that title, per 100 such commits made since 10 September. The six titles cover every commit.

title: Pull requests the most active account merged on its busiest day, by line of work
reading: Each bar is a count of pull requests merged that day whose branch names start the same way. The label is that shared start, as the project wrote it.
